scope: Read-only pinned source inspection; no HTTP, browser or model calls.
ordering: FIRST events in ascending database event ID order

source.src/routes.js: Only the parsed limit is passed to getTurnEvents; after/cursor parameters are not used.
source.src/metadataStore.js: listTurnEvents clamps limit to 1..5000; SQLite ORDER BY id ASC LIMIT; JSON fallback slice(0,safeLimit).
source.src/http/publicTurnStream.js: SSE registers a live per-turn listener before replaying first-N historical events; future terminal events are sent independently of that replay limit.

consequences: Initial Send confirmation does not disappear when event count grows beyond5000.
Late uncertainty or terminal events may be omitted from the bounded JSON history.
GET /turns/:id remains the separate authoritative terminal record.
A first5000-only uncertainty watcher cannot prove absence of late uncertainty.
The harness must retain events_may_be_truncated and distinguish missing historical events from missing terminal output.
